title: The judges of Nehardea

paragraphs: Hyman identifies this designation with R’ Abba bar Manyumi, as in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5) and [Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shevuot.6.8.2-3). The Arukh, under dan, transcribes Rav Adda bar Manyumi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Sanhedrin 17b text reads Rav Adda bar Minyomei, matching the type of variant Hyman attributes to the Arukh. His Rabbi Abba reading remains visible.

The linked Bavli gives Rav Adda bar Minyomei. The Yerushalmi cites the collective title without supplying this name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=930&lang=en) gives Acha in his main entry and attributes Adda to Yuchasin and the Arukh. Hyman’s identification uses Abba.
